notes.title: FISHTOPIA Update v1.2.6 Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We have now released the following updates:
[/p][p]1.Fixed an issue causing achievement descriptions to be inconsistent with their unlock conditions.[/p][p]2.Fixed an issue causing incorrect creature names in certain languages.[/p][p]3.Fixed an issue causing incorrect creature descriptions in certain languages.[/p][p]4.Fixed various text layout issues in certain languages.[/p][p]5.Fixed an issue that could cause creatures to stutter or freeze in the main scene.[/p]

notes.title: FISHTOPIA - Version 2.0 Development Plan
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]A huge thank you for all the incredible support and love you've shown for FISHTOPIA. Since the game's launch, we've been carefully reading all of your valuable feedback and suggestions. Your passion is the main driving force behind our work to improve the game and plan for its future! So, to give you a better idea of what's next, we're excited to share our upcoming updates and our long-term plans.  [/p][h3][b]
Upcoming Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]\[New Feature] Card Gifting[/b][/p][p]Players will be able to select any adult creature from their inventory and, at the cost of resetting its EXP, create a special copy that can be gifted to a friend.[/p][p][b]\[New Feature] Creature Storage[/b][/p][p]We are adding a storage space where you can temporarily keep creatures that cannot be used yet (e.g. those from a higher-level area than you have unlocked) or rare creatures you don't wish to sell.[/p][p][b]\[Improvement] Daily Income Projection[/b][/p][p]To help you better manage your resources, the main interface will display a projection of the estimated daily income of gold and crystals.[/p][p][b]\[Improvement] Wallpaper Mode[/b][/p][p]Creatures in Wallpaper Mode will automatically use their skills at a low frequency.[/p][p][b]\[New Content] Final Hidden Storyline[/b][/p][p]The final chapter of the hidden storyline will soon be available to be discovered.[/p][p][b]\[New Content] Full Collection Rewards[/b][/p][p]For players who have completed the entire creature collection, we will unlock three currently unavailable hidden scenes, one "??? Scene" and their exclusive background music.[/p][p][b]\[Bonus] Free Original Soundtrack (OST)[/b][/p][p]As a special thank you for all your support, once the game sells over 10,000 copies, we will produce a complete Original Soundtrack (OST) and release it for free to all players who own the game.[/p][h3]
[b]Long-Term Plans[/b][/h3][p][b]Wallpaper Mode Compatibility:[/b] We will work on fixing display issues in Wallpaper Mode, such as black bars or incorrect scaling on some dual-monitor setups and non-standard resolution displays.[/p][p][b]Broader Platform Support:[/b] We plan to add support for the Steam Deck and controllers.[/p][p][b]Physical Merchandise:[/b] We are planning to create physical versions of FISHTOPIA cards and Creaturepedia artbooks.

Thanks again for your support![/p]

notes.title: FISHTOPIA Update v1.2.2 Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,
[/p][p]We have now released the following updates:
[/p][p]1.Fixed an issue where the displayed gold cost for unlocking the next area did not match the actual amount paid.[/p][p]2.Fixed an issue where the skill for creature #184 was not taking effect.[/p][p]3.Fixed an issue where the skills for creatures #120, #121, #169, #170, #219, #220, #252, #253, #272, #273, #290, #291, #301, and #302 would not deactivate under certain conditions.[/p]

notes.title: FISHTOPIA Update v1.1.3 Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We have now released the following updates:
[/p][p][b]1.Added Exit Guide for Wallpaper Mode[/b][/p][p]We have added a tutorial on how to exit Wallpaper Mode. You will see the guide after updating the game and entering this mode.[/p][p]Reminder: You can always exit Wallpaper Mode by clicking the FISHTOPIA icon in your system tray (at the bottom-right corner of your desktop).
[/p][p][b]2.Fixed Steam Achievement Sync Issue[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue where achievements earned in-game were not displayed or synced correctly with the Steam client.
[/p][p][b]3.Fixed "Glittering Seahorse" Skill Bonus[/b][/p][p]Resolved an issue where the skill bonus for the "Glittering Seahorse" was not applying correctly.
[/p][p][b]4.Fixed Demo Save File Import Issue[/b][/p][p]The issue that prevented demo save files from being carried over to the full version has been resolved. You can now click "Continue" on the main menu to successfully load your progress from the demo.[/p]

notes.title: FISHTOPIA 1.0 is Officially Released!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]The full 1.0 version of FISHTOPIA is finally here! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628260/2cd142be611472fa4bb20381316f4cf5325518d1.png"][/img]

To celebrate the official launch, we are offering a 10% launch discount! If you love the game and wish to support us further, you can get an additional 10% off by purchasing the bundle that includes the base game and the Supporter Pack.
[/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who has been with us on this journey. Every bit of your support means a lot to us!
[/p][p]Now, a new journey begins. We hope FISHTOPIA brings you pure joy and moments of relaxation, becoming your personal sanctuary.[/p]

notes.title: v0.9.5 FISHTOPIA DEMO Update Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We've rolled out an update with some new features to make your gaming experience more convenient and enjoyable.[/p][p]Here are the details of this update:[/p][p][/p][h3]Quality of Life Updates[/h3][list][*][p]New One-Click Collect Button: We've added a button in the bottom-right corner of the game window to [b]instantly collect all your Gold and Crystals[/b]. Gathering your earnings is now easier than ever![/p][/*][*][p]New Offline Earnings Summary: You can now find an [b]offline earnings summary[/b] in the bottom-right corner. It displays the total amount of uncollected Gold and Crystals, allowing you to easily track your income while you were away or idle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]DEMO Save Transfer[/h3][p]We've always wanted FISHTOPIA to be a cozy corner for you in your busy life. It’s a place where you can simply relax and be happy, free from stressful tasks, enjoying your own healing moments.[/p][p][/p][p]Every landscape you've created and every creature you've nurtured in the DEMO is a part of that wonderful experience. We believe your valuable progress and the memories you've made shouldn't be lost.[/p][p][/p][p]That's why we've made it possible to [b]carry your DEMO save data over to the full version[/b] of the game. We want the joy and warmth you found in the DEMO to continue seamlessly into the complete world of FISHTOPIA.[/p][p][/p][p]Once the full game launches, just download it to have your save data transferred automatically. If you encounter any issues with your save file, please contact us via our Discord.[/p][p]Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/Ey3Hpm4aeb"]https://discord.com/invite/Ey3Hpm4aeb[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support! We can't wait to see you in the full version![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v0.9 FISHTOPIA DEMO Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]Thanks to all your passionate feedback, we've implemented several optimizations and feature updates. We're excited to roll out the v0.9 DEMO, and we hope these changes bring you even more enjoyment.
[/p][p]Here are the details of this update:
[/p][h3]Experience Optimizations[/h3][list][*][p]Wider Interaction Range: We've expanded the auto-collection range for Gold and Crystals, as well as the click-box for juvenile creatures, making every interaction smoother and easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer Icon Guidance: We've added hover tooltips to all in-game icons, making it easier for you to understand the function of each button.[/p][/*][*][p]More Convenient Collection System: Now, when you exit the game, the system will automatically collect all Gold and Crystals on the map, ensuring none of your hard work goes to waste.[/p][/*][*][p]Resizable Game Window: You can now freely resize and adjust the game window to the dimensions that best suit your screen and preferences.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Personalization and New Features[/h3][list][*][p]New [b]decoration management[/b] Feature is Live: The new decoration management tool is here! Now you can more easily browse, select, and arrange your beloved decorations to create your own unique deep-sea landscape.[/p][/*][*][p]A More Comfortable Visual Experience: In [b]Options[/b], we've added the [b]Lower Brightness[/b] and [b]Close CRT Scanlines[/b] settings. You can now adjust the display for a more comfortable visual experience.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes and Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]More Stable Inventory System: This update fixes issues where the inventory would occasionally experience display errors and data lag. Your assets and items will now be displayed more accurately.[/p][/*][*][p]Game Content Fixes: Adjusted some items in the shop and fixed an issue where some creature skill effects were incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Multilingual Support: Fixed bugs causing poor text formatting and display errors in some language settings, leading to an improved localization experience.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for your support and for being part of our journey! We hope you enjoy your time in FISHTOPIA![/p]
